## What changed and why

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Verification

List checks run and actual results. For code changes, run `npm run verify`. Explain any failures or skipped checks. Documentation-only changes need `git diff --check`.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] Behavioral changes include relevant tests and documentation.
- [ ] UI changes have been checked for keyboard use, narrow widths, and both themes, if applicable.
- [ ] Examples, screenshots, logs, and reports contain only synthetic data; no credentials or private project material.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this material under the repository's MIT license.
